note: City of Burwell campground in the city park on the North Loup River, separate from the rodeo fairgrounds. Four gravel pads off the park road south of the tennis courts; camper reports describe two back-ins and two pull-throughs with 30 A (one pedestal 50/30/15 A), water at a spigot (no site hookup), a coin shower and restrooms, and a dump station a few blocks away at the city sanitation facility. A reviewer with a 42-ft rig had room to spare. --Claude
summary: City camping page read today: Burwell City Park campsites first come first served, no reservations, $10 a night, phone 308-346-4509. Booking and fees now manual; hookups, sites and facilities left derived (the page states none of them). Phone missing: add. Water: not waterfront -> riverview (pads ~20 m from the river across the park road).
flags: WATER: not waterfront -> riverview. Imagery shows four diagonal gravel spurs just south of the tennis courts, off the park road's east leg. East of that road is a ~10 m open grass and riprap bank, then the North Loup River (channel ~60 m+, so river tier, not creek). Pad ends are ~20 m from the water with no treeline in between. The campground's own road separates pads and bank, which blocks on-water, so riverview. The stored evidence ('the pads sit back behind a treeline') doesn't match: the treeline is further south, past the pads.
